temporal_protocol.test_rule: purchase belongs to current test month

preprocessing_contract.post_pca_model_design: ORDER_CORE_V1 concatenated with volume PC scores and freight PC scores
preprocessing_contract.final_design_test_action: Transform TEST using TRAIN PCA objects and TRAIN StandardScaler only

classifier_contract.note: Class weighting is not tuned in the first K-utility experiment to avoid introducing another selection dimension.
classifier_contract.implementation_note: C is fixed at 1.0 before observing model performance. lbfgs is deterministic for this use; random_state is retained as provenance but is not operational for lbfgs.

full_functional_control.meaning: No PCA truncation within each 30-day functional channel.

primary.average_precision: Primary ranking metric for delayed-order class.

secondary_ranking.ap_lift_over_prevalence: Average precision divided by test-month positive prevalence.

operational.recall_at_05pct: Fraction of true delays captured among the highest-risk 5% of orders.
operational.recall_at_10pct: Fraction of true delays captured among the highest-risk 10% of orders.
operational.recall_at_20pct: Fraction of true delays captured among the highest-risk 20% of orders.

threshold_policy.reason: This stage evaluates ranking/probability performance before operational threshold selection.

functional_component_semantics.for_k_greater_than_zero: Fit one PCA on TRAIN purchase_volume RAW-30D curves and one PCA on TRAIN purchase_freight RAW-30D curves. Use the first K scores from EACH channel.

k_30.meaning: Full 30-dimensional PCA coordinate system for each of the two functional channels.

metric_aggregation_contract.formula: mean_AP(K) = (1/M) * sum_m AP_m(K), with M=17 temporal test months
metric_aggregation_contract.reason: Each future calendar month is treated as one temporal evaluation origin, preventing the largest months from fully dominating the primary comparison.
metric_aggregation_contract.pooled_metric_reason: Predictions come from separately fitted monthly models under changing class prevalence, so pooled metrics are not the primary model-selection criterion.

first_supervised_experiment.purpose: Measure whether RAW-30D functional components add out-of-time predictive utility beyond ORDER_CORE_V1.
